name: MS-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Incumbent Guest running with large cash advantage
No polls or expert ratings; fundamentals dominate
model.rationale: Guest is an incumbent in a district that leans Republican by fourteen points, and he has raised far more than his Democratic challenger. With no polling or expert ratings to contradict the fundamentals, the race stays near its baseline as Safe Republican.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing Guest under fifty percent or a late outside-spending surge could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Michael Guest, the Republican incumbent, seeks another term in a Mississippi district that voted Republican by about fourteen points in recent elections. His Democratic challenger, Michael Chiaradio, has raised only about $155,000 and had roughly $23,000 on hand, while Guest reported over $960,000 in cash. A Libertarian is also on the ballot. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so expectations rest on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the large financial gap. Prediction markets give Guest about a 98 percent chance of winning. The forecast expects Guest to win comfortably, with the main uncertainty coming from turnout variation rather than any specific campaign development.
